title: Drone Hits Dutch Embassy Compound in Kyiv, Ukrainian Officials Say
summary_full: Dutch officials said a projectile hit just behind the embassy compound, and that no one was harmed. Russia launched a wave of attacks into Ukraine’s capital on Thursday.
